run_d360_node: run the ROS2 D360 node to stream sensor data from the Digit360 device over serial
run_d360_node_fake: run the D360 node in fake data mode using the --fake flag for testing
create_digit360_serial_connection: create a Digit360 serial connection to read and decode COBS-encoded protobuf messages from a device port
review_timedelta_class: review the TimeDelta class that tracks timestamps and reports Hz and mean/std delta statistics
review_d360node_lighting: review the D360Node class lighting parameter system that loads LED config from YAML and writes to device
